statement: Build a one-file website for Riverside Run 2027, a city running event in Pune on Sunday 14 February 2027. Runners can compare the three races, calculate fees, register, see the schedule, routes and water stations, read FAQs and see sponsors. Volunteers can sign up separately.
audience: Runners of all ages and abilities in and around Pune, and people who want to volunteer. Most will use phones.
standards: Works well on phones: no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Photos, route maps and sponsor logos are clearly marked placeholders
rules: Use only the facts in the brief: no invented prices, times, names or contact details
Early-bird 10% applies to race fees only, never to T-shirts
T-shirt sizes offered are S, M, L and XL
Guardian name is required only when the runner is under 18
Registration form sends to run@example.com and volunteer form sends to volunteers@example.com
done_when: The site shows the name Riverside Run 2027, Pune, race day Sunday 14 February 2027, and expo day Saturday 13 February 2027, 10am to 6pm, at Riverside Grounds, 5 River Road, Pune 411001.
The site shows the contact details run@example.com and WhatsApp +91 00000 44444.

A race comparison shows 5K (start 7:30am, Rs 300, minimum age 12, cutoff 1 hour), 10K (start 6:45am, Rs 500, minimum age 16, cutoff 2 hours) and Half Marathon (start 6:00am, Rs 800, minimum age 18, cutoff 3 hours 30 minutes), and states the T-shirt price of Rs 250 (optional).

A fee calculator lets the visitor choose a race, 1 to 10 runners and a number of T-shirts, and shows the total. It takes 10% off race fees only (not T-shirts) for registrations up to 31 December 2026, and the code applies the T-shirt price of Rs 250 each.

A registration form has name, email, phone, date of birth, race dropdown, T-shirt yes/no, T-shirt size (S, M, L, XL, shown only when T-shirt is yes), emergency contact name and phone, and guardian name (required only when the runner is under 18), and is set to send to run@example.com.
A separate volunteer form has name, email, preferred role (Water station, Registration desk, Route marshal) and availability (Saturday, Sunday or both), and is set to send to volunteers@example.com.
A schedule shows Expo day (10am bib collection opens, 4pm route briefing, 6pm expo closes) and Race day (5:00am gates open, 6:00am Half Marathon, 6:45am 10K, 7:30am 5K, 10:00am prize ceremony).
Each of the three races has a route map placeholder and its water stations: 5K at 2.5 km; 10K at 2.5, 5 and 7.5 km; Half Marathon every 3 km.

An FAQ section answers: change my race (yes, until 31 January 2027 by email), parking (yes, free at Gate 2), refunds (no), bib collection (at the expo on 13 February), bag drop (yes, near the start line), pacers (yes, for the 10K and Half Marathon).
A sponsors section shows tiers: Gold (Meridian Bank), Silver (Trailhead Sports, Aqua Pure), Community (Pune Runners Club), with logo placeholders.
A countdown to race day (14 February 2027) is on the page and updates itself.
A menu stays on screen while scrolling and highlights the section the visitor is currently in.
A high-contrast mode toggle changes the colours of the whole page, not only part of it.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: Work out what they will pay
See the expo-day and race-day schedule
See route and water stations per race
Find the venue and contact details
See how long until race day
